what: JOC downmix configurations 1 and 2 (TS 103 420 table 47), and the temporal interpolation of two data points, checked on authored streams against the standard, not against Dolby. Dolby's decoder discards a rewritten JOC payload (keyed protection), so no comparison with it is possible; none was made
method: An independent reference of TS 103 420 clauses 6.5 and 6.6 (tools/joc_reference.py, not a copy of the Rust code) computes the matrices of 13 cases in f64; its Huffman trees are built from the ETSI table file (ts_103420_tables.c), read as data only. A payload writer written from clause 6.2 (crates/oadec-engine/tests/support/joc_writer.rs) writes the cases, and a carrier puts them into the metadata substream of E-AC-3 streams (crates/oadec-engine/tests/support/carrier.rs). The objects are decoded in memory (joc_pcm) and set against their source channel passed through the QMF analysis and synthesis banks alone, and against the core channel itself
commands: a numpy model of clauses 7.2 and 7.3 with the same prototype window, for the floor of the banks

the default outputs of the branch against the main release of d5fdd6c on every stream at hand: decode --format wav, --format damf with --loss-report and --format adm where the stream carries JOC, verify --json; logs compared without their speed lines

versions.oadec: oadec 0.9.1, release build of the round-4 JOC branch (c8b1f54)
versions.etsi_tables: ts_103420v010201p0.zip, 7 195 bytes, SHA-256 a79cf108c4529b7d9ca9525c871183a70b1732ed6df03a3d85b2f31be46eeced, from etsi.org; read as data, no file of it is in the repository

crates/oadec-eac3/tests/fixtures/joc-512.is: an authored scene (seven still objects, each a tone at -20 dBFS, a 55 Hz LFE bed) through oadec atmos-author and the Dolby Encoding Engine, frame groups 8 to 31: AC-3 core with a dependent substream of chanmap 0xa010, configuration 4, 15 objects; verify clean; each core channel carries its own tone and the others at least 90 dB below it

results.f64_matrices: 13 cases on 27 axes (selection, permutation, zero, negative, different gains, mixtures, dense and sparse, coarse and fine, eight band counts, smooth and steep with one and two data points, 24 slots, a frame edge, hold, absent, configurations 1 and 2): every matrix within 1e-12 of the reference
results.objects_to_their_channel_through_the_ban: configurations 1 and 2, coarse and fine, clip gain 1 and 1.25: 309.3 to 312.8 dB, peak difference at most 1.7e-16
results.objects_to_the_core_channel: 75.24 to 87.16 dB per object, peak difference 7.1e-6 to 6.8e-5; bounded by the banks

qmf_floor.reading: the prototype window of the banks is near perfect reconstruction: analysis then synthesis gives the input back at 75.7 dB, in the Rust code and in an independent numpy model with the same window alike; no JOC object can come closer than about 76 dB to its core channel. A property of the window, measured, not an error
qmf_floor.delay_samples: 577 (the best; 576 and 578 give 8.09 dB, 575 and 579 give 6.97 dB)
qmf_floor.window_perturbed: the window moved by one f32 ulp at random gives 75.72, 75.71 and 75.72 dB; rounded to f32 again 75.71 dB
qmf_floor.gain_ripple: the gain of the banks varies with frequency by 0.0014 dB (1.6e-4); after the best gain 78 to 98 dB remain

results.object_delay: 256 + 577 + 640 = 1473 samples from the constants, the best alignment 0 samples from it; nothing adjusted afterwards
results.two_data_points: the smooth and steep interpolation of two data points, the steep switch taking the one-based offsets, held to the reference and to the standard's reading; not measured against Dolby, no material carries them
results.missing_downmix_channel: a programme without a channel the configuration needs is refused with the names of table 47: configuration 2 over 7.1 names Tfl, Tfr; configuration 1 over 5.1.2 names Lb, Rb
results.mutations: 16 of 16 caught (the pair placements, the phase of configuration 2, the interpolation points, the dequantisation, table 54, the delay, the splice reset, the clip gain of the LFE, the naming of every missing channel)

default_outputs.list_sha256_is: SHA-256 of the lines '<sha256>  <folder>/<name>' of the 67 streams, sorted, joined by newlines
default_outputs.result: 67 of 67 identical to the main release: 26 carry JOC (configuration 0 once, 3 twenty-three times, 4 twice), 41 none

time: object decode (--format damf) of three configuration-3 streams, median of 9 alternating runs against the main release: -1.72, -1.32 and +0.52 per cent
open: the JOC offset validity check (a raw offset above 23, two offsets out of order) is not implemented
